notes.subject: tɔgɔsiralen muso
notes.rationale: העלמה means 'young woman (of marriageable age)'; LXX/NT tradition reads 'virgin' (parteno).

notes.subject: הרה as present
notes.rationale: Some read 'is pregnant' (present state, pointing to a woman standing there) rather than 'will conceive'.

notes.subject: Emanu-El
notes.rationale: The name is a sentence: 'El (is) with us' — kept as name plus a first-mention gloss.

notes.subject: taamasiyɛn
notes.rationale: A sign given, its timing and referent deliberately held within the prophecy.

notes.subject: to the house of Dawid
notes.rationale: The sign is addressed to the dynasty, 'aw ma' plural.

translation: O la, Adonay yɛrɛ bɛ taamasiyɛn di aw ma: Ee, tɔgɔsiralen muso min den dɔ la, o bɛ denkɛ dɔ bɔ, a bɛ wele a tɔgɔ ko Emanu-El (El bɛ an bɛma).
